summary: Talon.One: Berlin; promotions and loyalty engine used by 300+ global merchants. Adyen agreed to buy it for €750M (~$876M) cash on Apr 30, 2026; Adyen reported the deal closed Jul 1, 2026
Real-time offer decisioning at the moment of payment: "a merchant can recognize a shopper and apply a relevant offer instantly, before the payment is completed" (Ingo Uytdehaage, Adyen co-CEO)
Expected to add €60M of ARR by year-end 2026
Same payments-plus-loyalty bundle logic as Genius + Worldpay + Genius Loyalty, but with a global enterprise acquirer behind it
Restaurants are not a named core segment for Talon.One
Christoph Gerber & Sebastian Haas — Talon.One co-founders: "Joining Adyen allows us to embed real-time decisioning at the core of every transaction."
Integration led personally by co-CEO Uytdehaage

Adyen closed its Talon.One acquisition July 1, 2026 and began integrating its loyalty and promotion engine. (Scope note: Closing and planned integration do not prove a generally available combined restaurant product.)
